lede: Excelsior Springs fills the Hall of Waters with Christmas trees, lights up the Lane of Lights and runs a trolley past the holiday displays.
celebrates: Excelsior Springs celebrates Christmas around the historic Hall of Waters, where the Hall of Trees runs from November 21 through December 31 and Santa and Mrs. Claus take pictures on December 11. The Excelsior Springs Chamber runs the Holly Jolly Lights Tour on its trolley on December 11 and 19. The Parks, Recreation and Community Center hosts Winter at the Center on December 5 with a free Candy Cane Hunt, and the Mid-Continent library branch holds Grinch, Santa and holidays around the world storytimes. The Lane of Lights is already listed on this page.
facts: The Hall of Waters is at 201 E. Broadway. The Hall of Trees is open Monday to Friday from 10 am to 4:45 pm and Saturday and Sunday from 11 am to 4 pm, according to the town's Christmas guide. The chamber trolley leaves from 426 S Thompson Avenue and charges $13, with children 3 and under free on a guardian's lap. The Community Center is at 500 Tiger Drive and the library is at 1460 Kearney Road.
trains: Rally has not verified a Christmas train ride in Excelsior Springs for 2026, but the town's chamber trolley tour is the closest thing to a ride. The Kansas City page lists the metro's train and light events.

faq: Where can kids meet Santa in Excelsior Springs?
Santa and Mrs. Claus take pictures at the Hall of Waters, 201 E. Broadway, on Friday, December 11, 2026, from 6 to 8 pm. The town's Christmas guide lists it, and no price is printed.
When is the Excelsior Springs trolley lights tour?

The Excelsior Springs Chamber trolley runs the Holly Jolly Lights Tour on December 11 and December 19, with 6 pm and 7:30 pm routes. The ticket is $13 and children 3 and under ride free on a guardian's lap.
Is there a free Christmas event in Excelsior Springs?
Winter at the Center on Saturday, December 5, includes a Candy Cane Hunt from 9 to 10 am at the baseball fields, which the Community Center lists under its free events.
What is the Hall of Trees?
The Hall of Trees is a display of decorated Christmas trees at the Hall of Waters from November 21 through December 31. It is already listed on Rally's page with its own details.
